# FFmpeg binary dependency

Download and extract the BtbN LGPL shared Windows x64 package under this
directory:

https://github.com/BtbN/FFmpeg-Builds/releases

Expected asset name:

```text
ffmpeg-master-latest-win64-lgpl-shared.zip
```

Binary files in this directory are intentionally ignored by Git. The validated
1.2.x releases use FFmpeg N-128142-g28fda48e0b-20261028; its `ffmpeg.exe` SHA-256
was:

```text
d2750869506b0f15c8052790e4d22050616a5e6342ac7f9f92a026b65ca71821
```
